Prevention: Select a nursery bed in a sunny area with good aeration.
Keep soil dry and avoid poor drainage and compacted soil for nursery.
Solarise nursery bed with 250-300 gauge white plastic for 25 days prior to sowing seed.
Monitor temperature to ensure solarisation is effective.
Maintain proper spacing i.e., 10 x 2 cm for tomatoes or cucumbers.
Avoid the use of excess nitrogenous fertilizer.
Reduce the watering regime so the plants are mosty very dry. #REF!
Monitoring: Monitor the nursery for water- soaked lesions or constricted crown on plants at soil-line, or toppled plants.
Seedlings may be killed by damping-off as soon as they emerge so look out for dead seed shoots at soil level.
Once seedlings have grown on they are no longer susceptible to damping off.
Keep soil as dry as possible without affecting seedling development. #REF!
Direct Control: Apply copper oxychloride 50% WP covering seedling and soil surface.
Restrictions: When handling dressed seed or using agro chemicals ensure your are protected by wearing appropriate protection (gloves, mask, overalls).
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
Avoid inhalation of dusts when treating seeds.
